description: Path-based PR classification for the release notes. release-notes-data.py reads this file to tag every merged PR by the files it touched (behaviour spec: documentation/dev/release-notes-and-api-diffs.md, section 4.4). This JSON is the single deterministic place to edit the mapping - the script does not hardcode which paths are product/mixed/internal.
matching: Tiers are evaluated top-to-bottom; the FIRST tier with any file matching any of its patterns wins, otherwise `default`. A pattern matches a file path by PREFIX (str.startswith) - so `binding/` catches everything under it, and the bare `externals/skia` submodule gitlink matches itself. A pattern that contains a glob metacharacter (* ? [) is matched with fnmatch instead (e.g. `native/*/libHarfBuzzSharp/**`).

tiers.why: Shipped code - a real API / behaviour / native change a consumer can see. Written up in the notes.
Affects the shipped package but is not itself an API/behaviour change; Polish judges from the PR title/context and surfaces only a real behaviour change, dropping pure infra / doc churn.

notes: `externals/skia` is intentionally exact, NOT `externals/`: `externals/.gitignore` is build infra and must stay `default` (internal).
`native/` covers the per-platform build config (gn args / compile flags) and the shipped WinUI native subtree under `native/winui/`.
Anything not matched (CI, workflows, agent skills, the `documentation/` docs site, tests, samples, and build/meta files) falls through to `default`.
